description: This file contains implementations and autograd support for functional distributed collectives in PyTorch, including APIs like all_reduce, broadcast, gather, scatter, and their autograd backward functions, as well as utility classes like AsyncCollectiveTensor and infrastructure for tracing and remapping collectives.

classes.name: AsyncCollectiveTensor
classes.description: A tensor subclass that triggers a wait operation before first use, used to handle asynchronous collectives.

classes.name: _FromTorchTensor
classes.description: Autograd function to convert a tensor into an AsyncCollectiveTensor, enabling autograd propagation.

methods.name: wait_tensor
methods.description: Waits on a tensor returned by collective ops, blocking as needed.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts a tensor to all processes in a group.

methods.name: all_reduce
methods.description: Reduces a tensor across all processes with a specified operation.

methods.name: all_gather_tensor
methods.description: Gathers tensors from all processes and concatenates over a specified dimension.

methods.name: all_gather_tensor_autograd
methods.description: Gather tensors with gradient propagation support.

methods.name: reduce_scatter_tensor
methods.description: Reduces and scatters a tensor across processes.

methods.name: reduce_scatter_tensor_autograd
methods.description: Reduce and scatter with gradient support.

methods.name: all_to_all_single
methods.description: Performs an all-to-all operation with specified split sizes.

methods.name: permute_tensor
methods.description: Permutes tensor elements according to source/destination rank pairs.

methods.name: _expand_group
methods.description: Desugars various group representations into a canonical traceable format.

methods.name: _resolve_group_name
methods.description: Resolves a group in RANK_TYPES to a group name used internally.

methods.name: _maybe_wrap_tensor
methods.description: Wraps a tensor in AsyncCollectiveTensor if tracing, otherwise returns tensor.
